boundaries.captured-js-owned: synchronous bound functions, identical typed-input copies and target-owned outputs
boundaries.resident-wasm-destination: dedicated instance, capture setup excluded; packed output borrowed until next run
boundaries.instrumented-full-gpu-request: runtime capture/upload/stage dispatch/readback/unpack; per-call device-counter instrumentation inside timer; fallback separately labeled

protocol.consumption: Every returned vector word consumed inside timer with length + sum((index+1)*word) modulo2^32; common instrumentation overhead for all web variants; exact full output and lifetime checks outside timer
protocol.selection: same frozen engine/model; ordinary checked automatic planner; models are untrusted compile-time hypotheses
